correctness.rationale: For each odd-weight four-variable g, the nearest-affine error set has odd size s=1,3,5. A size-five minimum must be affinely independent by the hyperplane-toggle argument. Normal forms for the three affine-independent supports give explicit exact 5x5 matrices of ranks s. The degree-two graph restriction rank is 11+s, hence both annihilator dimensions are 5-s; degree-one impossibility and dimension 26>16 give AI exactly 2 or 3. The nonlinearity double-counting argument establishes NL(f)=2s. Independent exhaustive code checked all 32768 odd g truth tables, both graph ranks and all 2048 de Bruijn feedbacks; full checker returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The exact degree-two annihilator dimension quantifies vulnerability to quadratic algebraic attacks in a natural cryptographic feedback form. The same theorem identifies exactly which of the known 2048 de Bruijn feedback functions reach the sharp five-variable AI optimum. It couples two distinct design criteria by a structural normal-form proof, rather than merely reprinting a known frequency table; its complete all-odd-weight statement also applies beyond maximal-period registers.
